gloss: cash advance; provisional payment; temporary disbursement

definitions.gloss: cash advance; provisional payment; temporary disbursement
definitions.explanation: Money paid out before the final amount is known, to be settled up later. Typically an advance given to an employee for travel or entertainment costs, reconciled against receipts on return.

examples.japanese: {出張費|しゅっちょうひ}を{仮払|かりばら}いしてもらった。
examples.english: I got a cash advance for my business trip expenses.

examples.japanese: {仮払|かりばら}いの{申請書|しんせいしょ}を{経理|けいり}に{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the cash advance request form to accounting.

examples.japanese: {帰社後|きしゃご}に{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}を{添|そ}えて{仮払|かりばら}いの{精算|せいさん}をした。
examples.english: After returning to the office, I settled the cash advance with the receipts attached.

notes:
{仮|かり} (temporary, provisional) + {払|ばら}い (payment). The money is handed over first and the exact amount worked out afterward, so a {仮払|かりばら}い is always followed by a {精算|せいさん} (settlement).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仮払|かりばら}いを{受|う}ける: to receive a cash advance
- {仮払|かりばら}いを{申請|しんせい}する: to apply for a cash advance
- {仮払|かりばら}いの{精算|せいさん}: settlement of a cash advance
- {仮払金|かりばらいきん}: the advanced money (as a balance-sheet item)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前払|まえばら}い: advance payment — the amount is already fixed; no later settlement is needed
- {立|た}て{替|か}え: paying on someone's behalf — you use your own money first and are reimbursed
